title: EVE market order snapshot
description: One observed market order (character order or public region order) as a point-in-time snapshot, modeled directly on ESI's own market-order object with this package's camelCase field-naming convention (no existing wave-1 tool emits this shape yet, so there was no prior mapping to match — see this package's assignment report for that ambiguity note). This schema describes the record's `data`, not the enclosing envelope.

issued.description: ISO 8601 timestamp as returned by ESI.

range.description: ESI order range flag, e.g. "station", "region", a jump count as a string.
